name: ship-gate-ordering-docs
title: Document ship-loop gate ordering: PR-body tooling scope and KB refresh points
description: Document two ship-loop gate orderings that cost review rounds in practice: the pack.review-scope check requires a Tooling/generated scope heading in the PR body whenever tooling or generated files change, and .obsidian-kb must be refreshed after every documentation-affecting mutation including task.py archive, not only during sd-update-spec.
creator: sdelmas
notes: Sequencing: eleven active tasks edit .trellis/spec/backend/quality-guidelines.md. Cluster membership is decided by the PRD's stated deliverable -- a Requirement or acceptance criterion that writes to that file -- not by whether implement.jsonl lists it, since the manifest is a read-for-context list and several non-cluster tasks cite the file as a contract to read. `order` 10 within the P2 band encodes the intended landing sequence (ship-loop gate ordering: the base the others cite). Tasks with no `order` sort as 0 and therefore run before this cluster, which is intended: they do not contend for this file.
